name: don_t_generalize_when_assigment_target_i_eadb9e18
subject: Don't generalize when assigment target is never (fix: #41707)  (#59774)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Stops generalizing literal source types when the assignment target is never, so diagnostics show the original type (e.g. for assertNever) instead of the widened base type. This corrects displayed type text for an existing check.
